remarks: Come see this wonderful 2 bedroom, 2.5 bath Winnipauk Village condo overlooking the pool, it checks all the boxes! New kitchen in 2022 w/white cabinetry, quartz counters and stainless appliances. New kitchen window installed in 2023. New HVAC heat pump installed 12/2021. New dishwasher in 2025, stove and microwave in 2022 and washer and dryer 12/2021. Blinds in 2022. Hot water heater in 2022. Complex is being paved now and new fiberoptic will be installed. Complex has had new siding, roof and decks. Special assessment is paid off. Primary bedroom has a bath en-suite. Washer and dryer are located on the second floor. One reserved parking space and plenty of unreserved spaces. Beautiful grounds, 2 pools, kiddie pool, clubhouse, gym and pickleball courts. Pet friendly complex. HOA fee breakdown is $311 for general HOA and $210 for the SSD (special services district) making a total HOA monthly fee $521. Schedule your private showing today in this very well managed complex.
